storyModeWaterfall.title: Secret Waterfall
storyModeWaterfall.text: You should check behind every waterfall

m1006_zone.title: Horse betting
m1006_zone.text: Use this screen to bet on horses

m1006_zone2.title: Monster tournament
m1006_zone2.text: Use this terminal to watch and bet monster fights

m1006_zone3.title: Coin conversion
m1006_zone3.text: Use this machine to convert euros to tokens used for minigames and slot machines

m1023_zone.title: Ghent Hospital
m1023_zone.text: Visit hospitals to get your diseases diagnosed, install augments, change bodyparts and access to the [Fertility database]

m1414_zone.title: Inn
m1414_zone.text: Visit inns around the world to recruit new companions and rest

m1414_zone2.title: Hypermetro trains
m1414_zone2.text: Move between hub cities using the hypermetro! Your final destination is the Omega Tower, but you should stop at Ghent for stocking up on items.

m1414_zone3.title: Crafting
m1414_zone3.text: In this shack  you can find some materials, use the [Thinker] option in pause menu to assembly items and [Blacksmithing] to smelt and forge new ones

m1414_zone4.title: Farming plots
m1414_zone4.text: Use farming plots to grow your own plants

m1414_zone5.title: High level enemis
m1414_zone5.text: Some enemies are too powerful for your current party. when you are outside dungeons you can freely escape only in the first tur.

m1414_zone7.title: Dungeon
m1414_zone7.text: Explore dungeons to recover rare loot

m1414_zone8.title: Trash
m1414_zone8.text: Dive in the trash to recover hidden pre Y2K gems, but be wary of nausea.

m1414_zone10.title: Apiary
m1414_zone10.text: Use apiaries to manage a bee colony and collect honey

m1414_zone11.title: Farm
m1414_zone11.text:
You can take over this abandoned farm: it's owner was recently killed by getting hit via a satellite debris and nobody has claimed it yet.
Use the [Build] option in pause menu to buy animals and personalize this farm.

m1414_zone9.title: Library
m1414_zone9.text: Visit libraries to buy book and grimories

m1414_zone12.title: Clinic
m1414_zone12.text: Visit clinics to diagnose diseases, install augments, install or remove bodyparts or get medical training.

m1416_zone.title: PC
m1416_zone.text: Use this PC to access Hypernet

m1416_zone2.title: Quest board
m1416_zone2.text: Uset the quest board to accept quests

m1416_zone3.title: Bowling alley
m1416_zone3.text: Interact with the bowling alley to play bowling

m1416_zone4.title: Bathroom
m1416_zone4.text: Use bathrooms to clean yourself and increase your higiene. Higiene is important when talking to someone, unless he don't care about it.

m1416_zone5.title: Innkeeper
m1416_zone5.text: Talk to the innkeeper to rent a room, buy food or recruit troops

m1416_zone6.title: Sleep
m1416_zone6.text:
If your party sleep is low you will start losing MP,
make sure to rest everyday!
You can also drink coffee to keep you awake.

m1416_zone19.title: Minigames
m1416_zone19.text: Minigames use arcade coins to play but some are free. Use the arcade converter to get coins.

m1416_zone10.title: Renting
m1416_zone10.text: Interact with the door or talk to innkeeper to  rent a room

findTheInn.title: Somewhere to sleep
findTheInn.text: The inn stands at the middle of the station. Follow the lit windows and ask the landlord for a bed.

seeTheDoctor.title: See the doctor
seeTheDoctor.text: The clinic is the low building with the white door. Whatever is broken gets set in there.

searchTheWagons.title: Search the wagons
searchTheWagons.text: The siding has not been picked clean. Open every crate before the light goes.

intoTheCaves.title: Into the caves
intoTheCaves.text: The mouth in the hill runs deeper than it looks. Take a light, and something to swing.

headOutside.title: Head outside
headOutside.text: There is nothing more for you indoors. Step out and take the road.
